proof.momentum: At frozen support both complete APIC and complete delta have particle final linear/angular momentum equal to final grid momentum/angular momentum. Each invariant is linear in (v,C), including affine spin D=dx^2 I/4. One common scalar convex blend therefore has the same invariants for arbitrary nonaffine fields and arbitrary grid increments. x_new=x_old+dt v_new adds no orbital torque because v cross v=0.
proof.signed_G2P: g_b=K_grid(final)-K(z_b)=(1-alpha)g_A+alpha g_D+alpha(1-alpha)K(z_D-z_A). It is signed, not an APIC variance identity.
proof.work_balance: Original P2G correction K(z_old)-K_grid(old) plus signed G2P equals grid midpoint work minus particle kinetic change. Original stress/contact/boundary work signs remain unchanged; numerical corrections never become material heat.
proof.remap_limit: For fixed support zero-force T=APIC round-trip, delta=I; B_dt=alpha I+(1-alpha)T=I+(dt/tau0)(T-I)+O(dt^2). Over fixed duration t, B_dt^(t/dt) -> exp[(t/tau0)(T-I)], so remap filtering has finite duration-based loss instead of O(1) loss repeated per timestep. T is a contraction in the APIC kinetic metric, hence the zero-force blend is nonexpansive.
